editorial:
You wake up after a crash and your whole life has been stolen. Liam Neeson plays a doctor who wakes from a coma to find another man claiming his name, his wife acting like she doesn't know him, and a dangerous group closing in. With help from a young woman, he races through Berlin to prove who he is. The movie feels like a tense puzzle where every clue raises more questions, and you feel his panic as the world turns against him.

The action is sharp, the pacing rarely slows, and Neeson brings a steady, believable toughness to the role. The mystery keeps you guessing, though some twists may feel familiar if you watch a lot of thrillers. Still, it is a fun ride with strong set pieces and a satisfying payoff. Watch it if you enjoy identity mysteries and chase scenes. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you learn the man claiming his identity is part of a larger plot tied to a secret project. The hero discovers he was not just an innocent victim; he had a hidden past connected to the conspiracy. He fights off the attackers, protects the young woman, and clears his name. The twist reveals the truth about who he really is, and he walks away with a new chance at life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves identity mysteries, chase scenes, and Liam Neeson thrillers.
